episodes.title: Bool Hunt
episodes.summary: Lisey Landon begins to face repressed realities about her late husband, novelist Scott Landon, two years after his death.

episodes.title: Blood Bool
episodes.summary: Lisey calls Professor Dashmiel to warn him about Jim Dooley, who is already close at hand.

episodes.title: Under the Yum-Yum Tree
episodes.summary: The bool hunt leads Lisey to a moment from her past, when Scott shared a confession about his family and traumatic childhood.

episodes.title: Jim Dandy
episodes.summary: After a terrifying experience, Lisey opens up the gates of her memory to find answers in Scott's world of Boo'ya Moon.

episodes.title: The Good Brother
episodes.summary: Scott takes Lisey back to when she first learned about Boo'ya Moon and reveals the horrifying truth about his family's past.

episodes.title: Now You Must Be Still
episodes.summary: With Darla's help, Lisey sets out to rescue Amanda so the three sisters can unite to take on Jim Dooley.

episodes.title: No Light, No Spark
episodes.summary: Two years after Scott's death, Lisey must again confront mortality. But this time, she has a plan—and it involves Boo'ya Moon.

episodes.title: Lisey's Story
episodes.summary: Lisey faces Dooley and discovers Scott's final gift to her.
